generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force policies carrying TIV or sums insured across every line, peril, and CRESTA zone.
generic.In-scope period: In-force position as at the agreed exposure cut-off date for the current treaty year.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each policy row carries line of business, peril code, location or CRESTA zone, TIV, and currency.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Aggregated gross TIV and policy count tie to the policy admin in-force premium register within tolerance.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Aggregation workbook stored with the extract timestamp and the policy admin extract version reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policies with missing peril code or blank location listed with a fix, exclude, or accept disposition.
generic.Test population: The full aggregated in-force exposure set by line, peril, and geography at the cut-off date.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Gross TIV reconciles to the in-force register within tolerance and no null peril codes remain in scope.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved missing peril or location records are referred to the Catastrophe & Exposure Manager before release.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when totals reconcile, the as-at date is recorded, and every exception carries a disposition.
generic.Evidence location: Exposure aggregation folder in the lakehouse with the Excel summary and reconciliation attached.

steps.title: Extract in-force TIV and sums insured from the policy administration system
sop: Run the in-force extract in the policy administration system at the agreed cut-off date.
Include policy number, line, peril code, location, CRESTA zone, TIV, and currency.
Done when the in-force extract file is produced with its as-at date stamped.
verify: Check the extract as-at date matches the agreed cut-off date.
Pass when the extract exists with the correct as-at date and all required columns.

steps.title: Load the extract into the enterprise data warehouse staging area
sop: Load the extract into the lakehouse exposure staging table for the treaty year.
Confirm the loaded row count equals the extract row count.
Done when the staged exposure table is populated and row counts match.
verify: Compare staged row count to the source extract row count.
Pass when staged and source row counts are identical.

steps.title: Aggregate exposure by line, peril, and CRESTA zone in Microsoft Excel
sop: Pivot the staged exposure by line of business, peril, and CRESTA or postcode zone.
Sum TIV and policy count for each combination and hold currency separately.
Done when the aggregated exposure summary is built across all three dimensions.
verify: Check every line, peril, and zone combination present in staging appears in the summary.
Pass when no populated combination is missing from the aggregation.

steps.title: Reconcile aggregated gross TIV to the in-force premium register
sop: Compare aggregated gross TIV and policy count to the policy admin in-force premium register.
Investigate any difference above the agreed tolerance and record the cause.
Done when the reconciliation is completed and differences are explained.
verify: Check the reconciling difference against the agreed tolerance.
Pass when the difference is within tolerance or fully explained in writing.

steps.title: Flag policies with missing peril codes or blank location fields
sop: Filter the staged exposure for null peril code or blank location or zone.
List each affected policy with its TIV and assign a disposition.
Done when the exception list is complete with a disposition on every row.
verify: Check no exception row is left without a disposition.
Pass when every flagged policy carries a fix, exclude, or accept decision.

steps.title: Confirm facultative assumed treatment and release the aggregation
sop: Confirm whether inward facultative assumed business is included or excluded and state it on the summary.
Review the reconciliation and exception list before release.
Done when the aggregation is released for downstream modelling and structuring.
verify: Check the released summary states the facultative assumed treatment explicitly.
Pass when the release is recorded with the facultative treatment stated and exceptions dispositioned.

generic.Defined scope/population: The final net-retention strategy covering per-risk and per-event retentions for every line of business.
generic.In-scope period: Retentions applying from the stated effective date through the current treaty year.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approval record carries pack version, per-risk and per-event values, approver name, and effective date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every approved retention value matches the presented pack or a minuted in-session amendment.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed approval filed in the model governance repository with the approved pack version and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: In-session amendments to retention values logged with the reason and the amended figure.
generic.Test population: All per-risk and per-event retention values in the approved net-retention strategy.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Approval is valid only with a named approver, date, pack version, and stated effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Values differing from the pack without a minuted amendment are returned to the Head of Reinsurance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when signed approval, actuarial opinion, and effective date are all recorded together.
generic.Evidence location: Model governance repository approval folder with the SharePoint retention pack version linked.

steps.title: Confirm the retention pack version in SharePoint matches the version tabled
sop: Open the retention recommendation pack in SharePoint and note its version reference.
Confirm the tabled pack is the same version with no later draft outstanding.
Done when the pack version to be approved is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Check the recorded version reference against the SharePoint file version history.
Pass when the approved version reference matches the tabled pack exactly.

steps.title: Capture the actuarial function opinion on reinsurance adequacy
sop: State the actuarial opinion on the adequacy of the proposed reinsurance arrangement.
Record any reservation or condition attached to that opinion.
Done when the actuarial opinion is recorded against the pack version.
verify: Check the opinion is written, attributed, and dated.
Pass when a dated actuarial opinion covering adequacy is on file.

steps.title: Record per-risk and per-event retention values as approved
sop: Record the approved per-risk retention by line and the per-event catastrophe retention.
Record any amendment made in session with the original and amended value.
Done when every approved retention value is written into the approval record.
verify: Compare each recorded value to the pack and to the minuted amendments.
Pass when no recorded value differs from the pack without a minuted amendment.

steps.title: Obtain signed approval from the Head of Reinsurance
sop: Sign the approval page confirming the retention values and pack version.
Note CFO and CUO concurrence and any condition attached.
Done when the signed approval carries approver name and date.
verify: Check the signature block for name, role, and date.
Pass when the approval is signed and dated by the Head of Reinsurance.

steps.title: Set the effective date from which the approved retentions apply
sop: State the date from which the approved retentions take effect.
Confirm the date aligns with the treaty year and planned placement dates.
Done when the effective date is stated on the approval record.
verify: Check the effective date is not earlier than the approval date without a stated reason.
Pass when a coherent effective date is recorded on the approval.

steps.title: File the signed approval in the model governance repository
sop: Upload the signed approval and the approved pack version to the governance repository.
Link the approval reference to the retention rationale document.
Done when the approval is filed and retrievable by its reference.
verify: Retrieve the filed approval by its reference and check the pack version attached.
Pass when the signed approval and matching pack version are both retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: The selected peer set of reinsurers matched on line mix, premium size, and territory.
generic.In-scope period: Most recent published peer financials and current rating-agency capital adequacy commentary.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each peer row carries retention, surplus, gross written premium, and the source of the figures.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Peer retention ratios recompute from the stated surplus and premium figures without difference.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Benchmarking workbook retained with the peer data extraction date and source document versions.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Peers excluded from the set logged with the reason for exclusion.
generic.Test population: All peers in the selected set plus the company's own retention ratios.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Own retention must be positioned against the peer quartile range and the agency guidance threshold.
generic.Exception handling path: Outlier positions versus the peer range are explained in writing or escalated to the Reinsurance Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when peer basis, own ratios, agency guidance, and the implication for retention are documented.
generic.Evidence location: Benchmarking workbook in the lakehouse analysis folder with the Excel exhibit for the retention pack.

steps.title: Select the peer set and record the selection basis in Microsoft Excel
sop: Select peers matched on line mix, premium size, and territory.
Record the matching criteria and list any peer excluded with the reason.
Done when the peer set and its selection basis are documented.
verify: Check each peer against the stated matching criteria.
Pass when every peer in the set meets the recorded selection basis.

steps.title: Pull peer retention, surplus, and premium data into the warehouse workbook
sop: Extract published retention, surplus, and gross written premium for each peer.
Record the source document and its date for every figure.
Done when the peer data table is populated with sources cited.
verify: Check each peer figure traces to a cited source document.
Pass when no peer figure lacks a dated source reference.

steps.title: Express own retention as a percentage of surplus and of gross written premium
sop: Calculate own per-risk and per-event retention as a percentage of surplus.
Calculate the same retentions as a percentage of gross written premium.
Done when both own comparability ratios are calculated.
verify: Recompute the ratios from the underlying surplus and premium figures.
Pass when recomputed ratios match the stated ratios.

steps.title: Compare against rating-agency retention guidance thresholds
sop: Retrieve the current rating-agency capital adequacy commentary on retention guidance.
Compare own ratios against the stated guidance thresholds.
Done when the position versus agency guidance is recorded.
verify: Check the agency commentary cited is the current published version.
Pass when the comparison cites a current, dated agency source.

steps.title: Position own retention against the peer quartile range
sop: Calculate the peer quartile range for each retention ratio.
Mark where own retention sits and explain any outlier position.
Done when own position versus the quartile range is documented with explanation.
verify: Check every outlier position carries a written explanation.
Pass when no outlier is left unexplained.

steps.title: State the benchmarking implication for the recommended retention range
sop: Draw the conclusion on whether own retention is high, low, or in line with peers.
State the implied retention range for the recommendation.
Done when the benchmarking conclusion and implied range are documented.
verify: Check the conclusion follows from the peer and agency comparisons shown.
Pass when the implied range is supported by the exhibits in the workbook.

generic.Defined scope/population: Underwriting, ceded operations, and pricing teams plus all systems holding retention parameters.
generic.In-scope period: From the approved retention effective date through the treaty year the limits apply to.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Communication states per-risk and per-event values, effective date, and treaty year for each line.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Retention values in the policy admin and reinsurance admin systems match the approved retention table.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued retention notice retained with send date, recipient list, and approved pack version cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Teams or systems not updated by the effective date logged with owner and remediation date.
generic.Test population: All active treaty records and underwriting referral thresholds affected by the new retentions.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No active treaty or referral threshold may still carry the superseded prior-year retention value.
generic.Exception handling path: Systems still holding superseded values are escalated to the Reinsurance Manager for immediate correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when all recipients acknowledge and both systems reflect the approved values and effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Distribution log in the email and Teams record with system update evidence from the reinsurance admin system.

steps.title: Issue the approved retention table to underwriting, ceded ops, and pricing
sop: Send the approved per-risk and per-event retention table by email and Teams.
Name the approved pack version and the approval reference in the message.
Done when the retention table has been issued to all three teams.
verify: Check the sent message against the intended recipient list.
Pass when every named team received the retention table.

steps.title: State the effective date and treaty year in the communication
sop: State the date from which the retentions apply and the treaty year covered.
State that prior-year values are superseded from that date.
Done when the effective date and treaty year are stated in the issued notice.
verify: Check the notice text carries both the effective date and treaty year.
Pass when both are present and consistent with the approval record.

steps.title: Update underwriting referral and authority limits in the policy admin system
sop: Update referral thresholds and authority limits to the new retention values.
Set the change to take effect on the stated effective date.
Done when referral and authority limits reflect the approved retentions.
verify: Query referral thresholds in the policy admin system for the affected lines.
Pass when every threshold equals the approved retention with the correct effective date.

steps.title: Update retention parameters on treaty records in the reinsurance admin system
sop: Update the retention parameter on each active treaty record.
Confirm no active treaty still carries the prior-year retention.
Done when all active treaty records hold the approved retention values.
verify: List active treaties and compare their retention parameter to the approved table.
Pass when no active treaty carries a superseded retention value.

steps.title: Collect acknowledgements from each recipient team lead
sop: Request written acknowledgement from underwriting, ceded operations, and pricing leads.
Chase any lead who has not responded before the effective date.
Done when an acknowledgement is held from every recipient team lead.
verify: Check the acknowledgement log against the recipient list.
Pass when every recipient team lead has acknowledged.

steps.title: Log outstanding system or team gaps with owners and remediation dates
sop: List any system or team not aligned to the new retentions by the effective date.
Assign an owner and remediation date to each gap.
Done when every gap carries an owner and a remediation date.
verify: Check each logged gap has an owner and a date.
Pass when no gap is recorded without owner and remediation date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All retention options analysed for the cycle plus the recommended retention by line of business.
generic.In-scope period: The retention setting cycle preceding the treaty year the recommendation applies to.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pack contains recommendation, options exhibit, capital and cost exhibit, stress results, and sign-off page.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Figures in the pack agree to the source scenario and stress workbooks with no restated numbers.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Pack saved in SharePoint with a version number and the date it was assembled.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any exhibit missing at assembly logged with owner and the date it will be added.
generic.Test population: Every section of the assembled retention recommendation pack.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pack is complete only with recommendation, options, stress, benchmarking, and an unsigned sign-off page.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or inconsistent exhibits are returned to the Reinsurance Actuary before the pack is circulated.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when all five required sections are present and figures tie to their source workbooks.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint retention pack library with the supporting Excel exhibits linked to the pack version.

steps.title: Draft the recommendation section with alternatives considered and rejected
sop: State the recommended retention by line of business.
List each alternative considered and the reason it was rejected.
Done when the recommendation section names the recommendation and rejected alternatives.
verify: Check every alternative modelled appears with a rejection reason.
Pass when no modelled alternative is omitted from the section.

steps.title: Attach the capital relief and cost-of-cover exhibit for each option
sop: Insert the capital relief and net cost of cover figures for every retention option.
Confirm the figures agree to the scenario workbook.
Done when the exhibit is attached for all options.
verify: Trace a sample of exhibit figures back to the scenario workbook.
Pass when sampled figures match the scenario workbook exactly.

steps.title: Insert the 1-in-100 and 1-in-250 stress results at the recommended retention
sop: Insert net loss at the 1-in-100 and 1-in-250 return periods for the recommended retention.
State the tolerance threshold alongside each result.
Done when both stress results and their tolerances are shown.
verify: Compare the inserted results to the stress-testing output.
Pass when both return-period figures match the stress workbook.

steps.title: Insert the peer benchmarking exhibit and agency commentary
sop: Insert the peer benchmarking exhibit with own position versus the quartile range.
Include the rating-agency guidance commentary reference.
Done when benchmarking and agency commentary are in the pack.
verify: Check the benchmarking exhibit version matches the completed benchmarking analysis.
Pass when the exhibit matches the source benchmarking workbook.

steps.title: Add the sign-off page for Head of Reinsurance, CUO, and CFO
sop: Add a sign-off page listing Head of Reinsurance, CUO, and CFO with date fields.
Leave the page unsigned pending the approval session.
Done when the unsigned sign-off page is present in the pack.
verify: Check all three named signatories and date fields appear on the page.
Pass when the sign-off page is present, complete, and unsigned.

steps.title: Version and publish the assembled pack to SharePoint
sop: Review the assembled pack for completeness across all five sections.
Publish it to the SharePoint retention pack library with a version number.
Done when the versioned pack is published and circulated for the approval session.
verify: Open the published pack and confirm all five sections are present.
Pass when the published version contains every required section.

generic.Defined scope/population: Per-risk retention for every line of business plus the per-event catastrophe retention.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty year for which retentions are being set, using the current in-force exposure basis.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each selected retention carries the modelled net loss, earnings-at-risk, and capital impact beside it.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Modelled net losses at each retention agree to the actuarial platform scenario outputs.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Retention selection workbook retained with the model version and run date used to support it.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any retention breaching a board quantitative limit logged with the escalation and its outcome.
generic.Test population: All candidate per-risk and per-event retention values tested in the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No selected retention may project a solvency ratio below the internal capital target.
generic.Exception handling path: Retentions failing the solvency floor are rejected and re-set by the Reinsurance Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every value is recorded with net loss, capital impact, and a passed appetite test.
generic.Evidence location: Retention selection workbook in the lakehouse with the actuarial platform run reference recorded.

steps.title: Set per-risk retention by line against the earnings-at-risk tolerance
sop: Set a candidate per-risk retention for each line of business.
Compare the resulting earnings at risk to the approved tolerance.
Done when a candidate per-risk retention is set for every line.
verify: Check each line has a candidate value with its earnings-at-risk figure.
Pass when no line is left without a candidate retention and tolerance test.

steps.title: Set the per-event catastrophe retention against the 1-in-N net loss tolerance
sop: Set the per-event retention using the modelled OEP curve.
Compare net loss at the approved return period to the tolerance.
Done when the per-event retention candidate is set and tested.
verify: Check the net loss figure ties to the cat model output.
Pass when the per-event candidate is supported by a modelled net loss.

steps.title: Test each proposed retention in the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Run each candidate retention through the capital model.
Record the projected solvency ratio and required capital for each.
Done when every candidate has a modelled solvency and capital result.
verify: Check each candidate has a recorded solvency ratio.
Pass when no candidate lacks a modelled solvency result.

steps.title: Compare results to the solvency floor and internal capital target
sop: Compare each candidate's projected solvency ratio to the internal capital target.
Reject any candidate falling below the target and record the rejection.
Done when every candidate is marked pass or fail against the capital target.
verify: Check no retained candidate falls below the internal capital target.
Pass when all surviving candidates meet or exceed the capital target.

steps.title: Confirm the selection against board-approved quantitative risk limits
sop: Check the selected retentions against the board-approved quantitative risk limits.
Log and escalate any breach with the proposed treatment.
Done when the selection is confirmed against every applicable board limit.
verify: Check each applicable board limit has been tested against the selection.
Pass when no untested board limit remains and any breach is logged.

steps.title: Record selected values with net loss and capital impact in Microsoft Excel
sop: Record the final per-risk and per-event values in the selection workbook.
Record the modelled net loss and capital impact alongside each value.
Done when every selected value is recorded with its supporting metrics.
verify: Check each recorded value carries net loss and capital impact figures.
Pass when no selected value is recorded without supporting metrics.

generic.Defined scope/population: The approved net-retention strategy, the rejected alternatives, and the appetite metrics tested.
generic.In-scope period: The retention setting cycle covered by the signed approval record.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Rationale names selected value, rejected alternatives, appetite metrics, model version, and limitations.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every retention value cited in the rationale matches the signed approval record.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Rationale filed in the model governance repository with a version and cross-reference to the approval.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Known data limitations recorded with their effect on the conclusion and any mitigating action.
generic.Test population: All retention decisions documented in the rationale for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Rationale is complete only if rejected alternatives, appetite metrics, and model version are all named.
generic.Exception handling path: Gaps found at review are returned to the Reinsurance Analyst before the rationale is filed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the rationale is cross-referenced to the signed approval and reviewed by the Manager.
generic.Evidence location: Model governance repository rationale folder with the SharePoint working papers linked.

steps.title: Record why the selected retention was chosen over each rejected alternative
sop: List each alternative retention considered in the cycle.
State the specific reason the selected value was preferred to each.
Done when every rejected alternative carries a written reason.
verify: Check the alternatives listed match those in the recommendation pack.
Pass when no alternative from the pack is missing a rejection reason.

steps.title: Document the appetite metric and threshold each retention was tested against
sop: Name the appetite metric applied to each per-risk and per-event retention.
State the threshold value and the tested result.
Done when every retention has a named metric, threshold, and result.
verify: Check each retention in the approval has a matching appetite test.
Pass when no approved retention lacks a documented appetite test.

steps.title: List the model, version, and parameter set used to support the decision
sop: Record the actuarial and cat model names and versions used.
Record the parameter set and run reference for each supporting result.
Done when model versions and run references are documented.
verify: Check the recorded run references resolve in the governance repository.
Pass when every cited run reference is retrievable.

steps.title: State known data limitations affecting the retention analysis
sop: List the data quality or coverage limitations affecting the analysis.
State the likely direction and size of their effect on the conclusion.
Done when each limitation is recorded with its assessed effect.
verify: Check limitations raised in the exposure validation appear in the list.
Pass when no known validation limitation is omitted.

steps.title: Cross-reference the rationale to the signed approval record
sop: Insert the approval reference and pack version into the rationale document.
Confirm the retention values cited match the signed approval.
Done when the cross-reference is in place and values agree.
verify: Compare cited retention values to the signed approval record.
Pass when every cited value matches the approval.

steps.title: Review and file the rationale in the model governance repository
sop: Review the rationale for completeness against the five required elements.
File the reviewed version in the governance repository with a version number.
Done when the reviewed rationale is filed and retrievable.
verify: Retrieve the filed rationale and check all five elements are present.
Pass when the filed version contains all five required elements.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every per-risk and per-event retention limit set for the cycle across all lines of business.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty year covered by the current board-approved risk appetite statement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each mapping row carries the retention, the named appetite limit, escalation trigger, and owner.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The count of mapped retentions equals the count of retentions in the approved retention table.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Mapping table saved in SharePoint citing the board-approved appetite statement version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Retentions sitting outside the stated tolerance logged as exceptions with the agreed treatment.
generic.Test population: All per-risk and per-event retention limits in the approved retention table.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No retention limit may be left unmapped to a named risk appetite metric.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-tolerance retentions are escalated to the Reinsurance Manager and recorded as appetite exceptions.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every retention maps to a named limit and the appetite version cited is current.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint appetite mapping library with the Excel mapping table attached to the retention pack.

steps.title: Retrieve the current board-approved appetite statement from SharePoint
sop: Open the risk appetite statement library and select the current approved version.
Record the version reference and board approval date.
Done when the current appetite version is identified and recorded.
verify: Check no later approved version exists in the library.
Pass when the cited version is the latest board-approved one.

steps.title: Map each per-risk retention to its underwriting appetite limit
sop: List each per-risk retention by line of business.
Name the underwriting risk appetite limit it is constrained by.
Done when every per-risk retention has a named appetite limit.
verify: Count mapped per-risk retentions against the approved retention table.
Pass when the counts match with no unmapped per-risk retention.

steps.title: Map each per-event retention to catastrophe and earnings volatility tolerances
sop: Name the catastrophe tolerance and earnings volatility tolerance for each per-event retention.
Record the threshold value from the appetite statement.
Done when each per-event retention carries both tolerance references.
verify: Check each per-event mapping cites a threshold from the appetite statement.
Pass when every per-event retention has a cited threshold.

steps.title: Identify retentions sitting outside the stated tolerance
sop: Compare each retention's tested result to its mapped tolerance.
Mark any line breaching tolerance as an appetite exception.
Done when every retention is marked in or out of tolerance.
verify: Check each out-of-tolerance line is recorded as an exception.
Pass when no breach is left unmarked.

steps.title: Record the escalation trigger and owner for each mapped limit
sop: State the trigger level at which each mapped limit escalates.
Name the owner accountable for monitoring that limit.
Done when every mapping row carries a trigger and an owner.
verify: Check no mapping row is missing a trigger or an owner.
Pass when trigger and owner are populated on every row.

steps.title: Review the completed mapping table with the Reinsurance Manager
sop: Review the mapping for completeness and correct appetite references.
Approve the exception treatments proposed for out-of-tolerance lines.
Done when the mapping table is reviewed and the exceptions are accepted.
verify: Check the review is recorded against the mapping version.
Pass when a dated review is recorded and all exceptions carry a treatment.

generic.Defined scope/population: At least two retention options with their cost of cover, capital relief, and volatility impact.
generic.In-scope period: The retention setting cycle ahead of the treaty year being planned.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each option shows cost of cover, capital relief, 1-in-100 and 1-in-250 net loss, and solvency impact.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Option figures presented agree to the scenario and stress workbooks without restatement.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Presented deck and minutes stored in SharePoint with the session date and deck version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Challenges raised by the CUO or CFO logged with the response or the follow-up action assigned.
generic.Test population: All retention options tabled at the CUO and CFO session.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Session is complete only when a selection or a defined further-analysis request is recorded.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved challenges are converted into actions with an owner and due date by the Head of Reinsurance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when minutes record options presented, challenges, responses, and the direction given.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint retention governance folder holding the deck, minutes, and the emailed action list.

steps.title: Prepare the options deck in SharePoint with cost and capital side by side
sop: Build slides showing at least two retention options with cost of cover and capital relief.
Confirm figures tie to the scenario workbook before circulating.
Done when the options deck is prepared and version stamped.
verify: Trace sampled deck figures to the scenario workbook.
Pass when sampled figures match the source workbook.

steps.title: Add net loss at the 1-in-100 and 1-in-250 return periods per option
sop: Insert net loss at both return periods for each option.
Show the tolerance threshold against each figure.
Done when both return-period figures appear for every option.
verify: Check each option carries both return-period figures.
Pass when no option is missing a return-period result.

steps.title: Add the earnings volatility and solvency ratio impact per option
sop: Insert earnings volatility and projected solvency ratio for each option.
State the internal capital target alongside for comparison.
Done when volatility and solvency impacts are shown for every option.
verify: Check the solvency figures match the capital model output.
Pass when solvency figures reconcile to the capital model run.

steps.title: Present the retention options to the CUO and CFO
sop: Walk the CUO and CFO through each option and its trade-offs.
Invite challenge on cost, capital, and volatility.
Done when all options have been presented in the session.
verify: Check the attendance record includes the CUO and CFO.
Pass when both attended and all options were tabled.

steps.title: Capture challenges and responses in the session minutes
sop: Record each challenge raised and the response given in the session.
Note where a response was deferred to further analysis.
Done when every challenge and response is minuted.
verify: Check no minuted challenge is left without a response or deferral.
Pass when every challenge carries a response or a deferral note.

steps.title: Record the option selected or the analysis requested with owner and date
sop: Record the option selected or the further analysis directed.
Assign an owner and due date to each follow-up action.
Done when the direction and any actions are recorded in the minutes.
verify: Check each action has an owner and a due date.
Pass when the minutes carry a clear direction and fully assigned actions.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every candidate retention scenario run gross and net through the capital model.
generic.In-scope period: The capital model valuation date underlying the retention setting cycle.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each scenario carries required capital gross and net, model version, and parameter set reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Gross required capital is identical across scenarios and matches the base capital model run.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scenario outputs stored in the model governance repository with run identifier and run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Scenarios failing the effective risk transfer test logged with the reason and treatment.
generic.Test population: All candidate retention scenarios modelled for the cycle.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No scenario result may be stored without a recorded model version and parameter set.
generic.Exception handling path: Scenarios without valid risk transfer recognition are excluded and escalated to the Reinsurance Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every scenario shows gross and net capital, relief, and relief per unit of spend.
generic.Evidence location: Model governance repository scenario folder with the lakehouse input extract referenced.

steps.title: Run the capital model gross of reinsurance as the base case
sop: Run the capital model on the current exposure with no reinsurance applied.
Record the run identifier, model version, and parameter set.

steps.title: Confirm each scenario meets the effective risk transfer conditions

steps.title: Tabulate net cost of cover against capital relief per option

generic.Defined scope/population: Every appetite metric and capital target that constrains ceded reinsurance decisions.

steps.title: Retrieve the board-approved risk appetite statement from SharePoint

Record its version reference and board approval date.
Done when the current appetite version and approval date are recorded.
verify: Check no later approved version exists in the library.
Pass when the cited version is the latest board-approved statement.

steps.title: List every appetite metric constraining ceded reinsurance decisions
sop: Extract the metrics that constrain retention, limit, and counterparty decisions.
Record the threshold value for each metric.
Done when every constraining metric is listed with its threshold.
verify: Cross-check the list against the metrics named in the appetite statement.
Pass when no constraining metric from the statement is omitted.

steps.title: Identify threshold and capital target changes since the last cycle
sop: Compare current thresholds to those used in the previous renewal cycle.
Record each change with its old and new value.
Done when all changes since the last cycle are recorded.
verify: Check each recorded change shows both old and new values.
Pass when every change carries a before and after value.

steps.title: Confirm ORSA capital plan reinsurance dependency assumptions are current
sop: Pull the ORSA capital plan assumptions on reinsurance dependency from the lakehouse.
Confirm they still reflect the intended program and retention basis.
Done when the dependency assumptions are confirmed or flagged as stale.
verify: Check the assumption extract date against the current planning cycle.
Pass when the assumptions used are from the current planning cycle.

steps.title: Record the implications for this cycle's retention setting
sop: State how each identified change affects the retention range available this cycle.
Highlight any metric that now binds more tightly than last cycle.
Done when the implications are written into the review note.
verify: Check every identified change has a stated implication.
Pass when no change is recorded without an implication.

steps.title: Publish the review note and hand it to retention setting
sop: Publish the review note to the SharePoint reinsurance strategy folder.
Circulate it to the retention setting team as the constraint baseline.
Done when the note is published and handed to the retention setting workstream.
verify: Check the published note cites the appetite version and lists changes.
Pass when the published note contains both elements and is circulated.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every candidate retention tested at the 1-in-100 and 1-in-250 return periods plus a two-event year.

generic.Exception handling path: Candidates breaching earnings or capital tolerance are referred back to retention setting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the scenario set, event basis, and model version are documented with the results.
generic.Evidence location: Model governance repository stress folder with the cat model run outputs attached.

steps.title: Confirm the event set and model version in the cat model platform
sop: Select the approved event set and record the cat model name and version.
Confirm the exposure extract used is the validated one.
Done when the event basis and model version are fixed and recorded.
verify: Check the recorded model version is on the approved vendor model list.
Pass when the version used is approved and recorded.

steps.title: Run net position at 1-in-100 and 1-in-250 for each candidate retention
sop: Apply each candidate retention to the event loss table.

Done when both return-period results exist for every candidate.
verify: Check each candidate has both return-period results.
Pass when no candidate is missing a return-period figure.

steps.title: Run the two-event year scenario to test reinstatement adequacy

Apply reinstatement provisions and record the net outcome.

verify: Check the two-event run applies the reinstatement terms of the candidate structure.
Pass when reinstatement terms are reflected in the two-event result.

steps.title: Compare net losses to the earnings and capital tolerance thresholds
sop: Compare each net loss to the earnings tolerance and the capital tolerance.
Mark each result as within or outside tolerance.
Done when every result is marked against both tolerances.
verify: Check no result is left unmarked against a tolerance.
Pass when every result carries a tolerance assessment.

steps.title: Identify the return period at which each candidate first breaches tolerance
sop: Locate the first return period where each candidate exceeds tolerance.
Record that breach point against the candidate.
Done when each candidate has a breach point or is marked as non-breaching.
verify: Check each candidate has a breach point or a non-breach statement.
Pass when no candidate is left without a breach assessment.

steps.title: Document the scenario set and results in the governance repository
sop: Record the scenario set, event basis, model version, and run identifier.
Upload the results table to the model governance repository.
Done when the stress results and their assumptions are filed together.
verify: Retrieve the filed results and check the assumption record is attached.
Pass when results and assumption record are retrievable as one package.

steps.title: Assess rating-agency capital model treatment and counterparty charge
sop: Assess how each option is treated in the rating-agency capital model.

verify: Check the agency rules cited are the current published version.

steps.title: Flag options relying on unregistered or unauthorised reinsurers
sop: Identify options whose panel includes unregistered or unauthorised reinsurers.

Done when every such option is flagged with its collateral requirement.
verify: Check each flagged option states a specific collateral requirement.
Pass when no flagged option lacks a stated collateral requirement.

steps.title: Record regulatory reporting consequences for outgoing reinsurance templates
sop: State how each option affects the outgoing reinsurance regulatory templates.

Done when reporting consequences are recorded for every option.
verify: Check each option has a reporting consequence entry.

steps.title: Review the assessment and confirm the surviving shortlist

Remove any option failing risk transfer or credit tests from the shortlist.
Done when the reviewed assessment and the surviving shortlist are published.
verify: Check each surviving option passes both risk transfer and credit tests.
Pass when no failing option remains on the shortlist.

generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force and pipeline risks eligible for cession in the treaty year being structured.

steps.title: Extract in-force and pipeline risks from the policy administration system

verify: Check each classified risk names the rule applied.
Pass when no risk is classified without a named rule.

steps.title: Flag risks exceeding treaty limits or in excluded classes as facultative-only
sop: Identify risks above the treaty limit or in an excluded class.

verify: Check no risk above the treaty limit is still marked treaty-cedable.
Pass when no over-limit risk remains classified as treaty.

steps.title: Identify excluded perils and non-standard wordings needing facultative support
sop: Review risks with excluded perils or non-standard wordings.

verify: Check each marked risk names the excluded peril or wording issue.

Done when the borderline list is produced and routed.
verify: Check no borderline risk carries an automatic classification.
Pass when all borderline risks are marked as referred.

sop: Decide the classification for every referred risk and record the reason.
Publish the schedule with estimated ceded premium split by treaty and facultative.
Done when the schedule is published with all referrals decided.
verify: Check the published schedule has no undecided referral.
Pass when every risk carries a final classification and premium split.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full proposed program structure including every layer, its terms, and its supporting assumptions.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when an independent reviewer signs off with all findings closed or formally accepted.

steps.title: Confirm reviewer independence from the structure being reviewed
sop: Confirm the reviewer did not prepare or approve the structure under review.

Done when reviewer independence is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Check the reviewer is not named as preparer of the structure document.
Pass when reviewer and preparer are different named individuals.

steps.title: Check attachment points, limits, and reinstatements for consistency
sop: Recompute attachment and exhaustion points for every layer in the tower.
Check reinstatement counts and aggregate limits are internally consistent.
Done when every layer's terms have been recomputed and checked.
verify: Check each recomputed figure against the structure document.
Pass when recomputed terms match the documented terms.

steps.title: Challenge the key modelling assumptions behind the recommended tower
sop: Identify the assumptions the tower is most sensitive to.
Challenge each and record the response or the required rework.
Done when each key assumption has been challenged and answered.
verify: Check each challenged assumption has a recorded response.
Pass when no challenge is left unanswered.

steps.title: Confirm no gap or unintended overlap between adjacent layers
sop: Compare each layer's exhaustion to the next layer's attachment.
Identify overlaps where two covers respond without an inuring clause.
Done when the full tower has been checked for gaps and overlaps.
verify: Check every adjacent layer pair has been assessed.
Pass when no unexplained gap or overlap remains.

steps.title: Log each finding with an owner in the governance repository
sop: Log every finding with the affected layer or assumption and an owner.
Set a closure date for each finding.
Done when every finding is logged with an owner and closure date.
verify: Check no logged finding lacks an owner or a date.
Pass when all findings carry owner and closure date.

steps.title: Confirm closure of all findings before the pack proceeds to approval
sop: Review the finding log and confirm each is closed or formally accepted.
Release the structure for approval only once the log is clear.
Done when the finding log is clear and the release is recorded.
verify: Check the finding log status at the point of submission.
Pass when no finding is open at submission.

generic.Defined scope/population: Proportional and non-proportional layers designed for every line of business in the program.

sop: Set the quota share cession percentage for each line where proportional cover is used.

Set the layer limits stacking above the attachment.

steps.title: Set catastrophe XoL attachment and exhaustion against the modelled OEP curve
sop: Place the cat XoL attachment and exhaustion against the modelled OEP curve.

sop: Set the reinstatement count and terms for each non-proportional layer.

verify: Check no non-proportional layer is missing reinstatement terms.
Pass when all non-proportional layers carry reinstatement terms.

steps.title: Add an aggregate stop-loss where frequency risk is retained
sop: Identify lines where retained frequency risk justifies a stop-loss.

Done when stop-loss cover is defined or explicitly ruled out per line.
verify: Check each line has a stop-loss decision recorded.
Pass when no line is left without a stop-loss decision.

steps.title: Publish the layer schedule and stage it in the reinsurance admin system
sop: Publish the completed layer schedule from Excel with a version reference.
Stage the layer parameters in the reinsurance administration system.

Pass when staged parameters match the published schedule exactly.

sop: Open the blueprint and confirm the approval reference and version are recorded on it.
Do not release any version lacking an approval reference.

steps.title: Send the layer schedule and cession terms to the placement team
sop: Email the layer schedule and cession terms to the placement team.

Mark the records as pending placement until terms are bound.

verify: Compare the staged structure to the approved blueprint layer by layer.
Pass when the staged structure matches the blueprint.

steps.title: Withdraw or supersede earlier draft blueprints
sop: Identify earlier drafts circulated to the same recipients.
Notify recipients that those drafts are superseded and mark them in SharePoint.
Done when every earlier draft is marked superseded.
verify: Check the SharePoint library for drafts still marked current.
Pass when no superseded draft remains marked current.

steps.title: Log the distribution date and recipient acknowledgements
sop: Record the send date, version, and recipient list in the distribution log.
Chase and record acknowledgement from each recipient.
Done when every recipient acknowledgement is logged.
verify: Compare the acknowledgement log to the recipient list.
Pass when every recipient has an acknowledgement recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every layer in the recommended structure plus the alternatives evaluated and rejected.

sop: List the assumptions the structure is most sensitive to.

sop: Review the document for completeness against the five required elements.
Version it in SharePoint and file a copy in the governance repository.

steps.title: Model facultative cover sitting inside the treaty retention

steps.title: Model facultative cover sitting above the treaty retention

generic.Defined scope/population: Every layer in the program tower from the lowest attachment to the top exhaustion point.

steps.title: Identify overlaps where two covers respond without an inuring clause

sop: Rank layers on expected loss to layer relative to rate on line.

generic.Defined scope/population: The documented program structure submitted for approval and the conditions attached to it.

steps.title: Confirm allocations sum to total ceded cost with no residual
sop: Sum all allocations and compare to total ceded cost of cover.
Investigate and clear any residual.
Done when the allocation total equals the ceded cost total.
verify: Compare the allocation total to the ceded cost total.
Pass when no unallocated residual remains.

steps.title: Circulate the allocation basis and results to business unit finance leads
sop: Send the driver basis and allocated amounts to each affected finance lead.
Record acknowledgement or challenge from each lead.
Done when the allocation is circulated and responses recorded.
verify: Check every affected unit received the allocation.
Pass when all affected units received it and responses are logged.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every non-proportional layer and proportional treaty in the placed or planned program.
generic.In-scope period: The treaty year for which layer costs and rates on line are being calculated.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each layer holds premium, limit, reinstatement premium, commissions, brokerage, and expected recoveries.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Layer premiums sum to total ceded premium per program in the ceded accounting platform.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Cost workbook retained with the treaty data extract date and the pricing assumption version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Layers where net cost exceeds expected recovery beyond the agreed margin flagged with a comment.
generic.Test population: All layers and treaties in the program cost calculation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No layer may be left without a rate on line and a net cost of cover figure.
generic.Exception handling path: Flagged uneconomic layers are referred to the Reinsurance Accountant and the structuring team.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every layer shows rate on line, net cost, and a prior-year comparison.
generic.Evidence location: Excel cost workbook with Sapiens ReinsurancePro treaty data and ceded accounting balances referenced.

steps.title: Extract layer premium and limit data from Sapiens ReinsurancePro
sop: Extract premium, limit, and reinstatement terms for every layer.
Record the extract date against the workbook.
Done when layer data is extracted for the whole program.
verify: Compare extracted layer count to the placed program schedule.
Pass when counts match with no layer missing.

steps.title: Calculate rate on line for every non-proportional layer
sop: Divide layer premium by layer limit for each non-proportional layer.
Record the rate on line beside each layer.
Done when every non-proportional layer has a rate on line.
verify: Recompute rate on line for a sample of layers.
Pass when recomputed rates match the reported rates.

steps.title: Calculate net cost including reinstatements and recoveries
sop: Add reinstatement premium to ceded premium for each layer.
Deduct expected recoveries and commissions to get net cost.
Done when net cost is calculated for every layer.
verify: Recompute net cost from its components for a sample layer.
Pass when the recomputed figure matches the reported net cost.

steps.title: Include brokerage and override commission in the net cost
sop: Add brokerage and any profit or override commission to the calculation.
Reconcile the amounts to the ceded accounting platform.
Done when brokerage and commissions are included and reconciled.
verify: Compare included amounts to the ceded accounting balances.
Pass when included amounts agree to ceded accounting.

steps.title: Compare rate on line to prior year and to expected loss to layer
sop: Compare each layer's rate on line to the prior year figure.
Compare it to the modelled expected loss to layer.
Done when both comparisons exist for every layer.
verify: Check both comparison columns are populated per layer.
Pass when no layer is missing a comparison.

steps.title: Flag layers where net cost exceeds expected recovery
sop: Identify layers where net cost exceeds expected recovery beyond the agreed margin.
Flag each with a comment for the structuring team.
Done when all such layers are flagged with comments.
verify: Check each flagged layer carries a comment.
Pass when no flagged layer lacks a comment.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every program and layer with an actual-to-budget variance above the materiality threshold.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period being explained plus the year-to-date position.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each variance row carries program, layer, budget, actual, variance, components, and owner.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rate, volume, and timing components sum to the total variance for each program.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Variance analysis retained with the ceded accounting extract date and the budget version cited.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Variances traced to posting errors logged with the correcting journal reference.
generic.Test population: All programs and layers with a variance in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No variance above the materiality threshold may be left unexplained.
generic.Exception handling path: Variances without an identified driver are escalated to the Reinsurance Manager for investigation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every material variance has components, an owner, and a reversal expectation.
generic.Evidence location: Excel variance workbook with ceded accounting and general ledger entries referenced.

steps.title: List variances above the materiality threshold by program and layer
sop: Compare actual ceded spend to budget by program and layer.
List every variance exceeding the materiality threshold.
Done when the material variance list is produced.
verify: Check the threshold applied matches the agreed materiality level.
Pass when the applied threshold matches the agreed level.

steps.title: Split each variance into rate, volume, and timing components
sop: Attribute each variance to rate movement, volume movement, and instalment timing.
Record each component against the total.
Done when every material variance is fully attributed.
verify: Check the components sum to the total variance per row.
Pass when components reconcile with no residual.

steps.title: Separate adjustment, reinstatement, and endorsement effects
sop: Identify variance caused by adjustment premium, reinstatements, or endorsements.
Show these separately from underlying rate and volume effects.
Done when these effects are separately identified.
verify: Check each identified effect ties to a ceded accounting transaction.
Pass when each effect traces to a ceded transaction.

steps.title: Trace variances to ceded accounting entries to rule out posting errors
sop: Trace each material variance to the underlying ceded accounting entries.
Raise a correcting journal where a posting error is found.
Done when every material variance has been traced.
verify: Check any posting error identified has a correcting journal reference.
Pass when every posting error carries a journal reference.

steps.title: Record the explanation, owner, and reversal expectation
sop: Write the explanation for each material variance.
Name the owner and state whether it is expected to reverse by year end.
Done when explanation, owner, and expectation are recorded.
verify: Check no material variance is missing any of the three fields.
Pass when all three fields are populated on every row.

steps.title: Review the variance analysis with the Reinsurance Manager
sop: Review the explanations and the ownership assigned.
Challenge any explanation not supported by the components shown.
Done when the analysis is reviewed and accepted.
verify: Check the review decision is recorded against the analysis version.
Pass when a dated review decision is recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: The complete reinsurance budget submission covering every program, layer, and business unit.
generic.In-scope period: The planning period the budget covers as set by the budget calendar.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Submission holds ceded premium by program and layer, sensitivity range, and unit allocations.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ceded premium totals in the submission agree to the supporting forecast workbook.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Final submission numbered and stored in SharePoint with the submission date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Review feedback items logged with whether they were incorporated or set aside with a reason.
generic.Test population: All budget lines and all review feedback items for the submission.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No review feedback item may be left unincorporated without a recorded reason.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved feedback is escalated to the Reinsurance Manager before the submission deadline.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the numbered submission is loaded into planning by the calendar deadline.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint budget library with the Excel forecast workbook and the ERP planning system entry.

steps.title: Incorporate agreed changes from the finance and underwriting review
sop: Work through the review action log and apply each agreed change.
Record any item not incorporated with the reason.
Done when every review item is applied or reasoned out.
verify: Check the action log against the changes applied.
Pass when no item is left without an applied change or reason.

steps.title: Confirm ceded premium by program and layer agrees to the forecast workbook
sop: Compare submission ceded premium by program and layer to the forecast workbook.
Correct any difference before submission.
Done when the submission and forecast agree.
verify: Compare the totals in both files.
Pass when no difference remains between them.

steps.title: Include the sensitivity range and assumed market rate change
sop: Insert the sensitivity range beside the central case.
State the assumed market rate change and its source.
Done when range and rate assumption are included.
verify: Check the range ties to the sensitivity modelling output.
Pass when the range matches the sensitivity output.

steps.title: Confirm business unit allocations are included and sum to the total
sop: Include the allocation by business unit in the submission.
Confirm allocations sum to the total budget.
Done when allocations are included and reconciled.
verify: Sum the allocations and compare to the total budget.
Pass when the allocations equal the total budget.

steps.title: Number and publish the final submission to SharePoint
sop: Apply a submission number and publish the final version.
Withdraw earlier drafts from the library.
Done when the numbered submission is published.
verify: Check no earlier draft is still marked current.
Pass when only the numbered submission is marked current.

steps.title: Submit the final version into the planning system by the deadline
sop: Load the final submission into the ERP planning system.
Confirm submission before the budget calendar deadline.
Done when the submission is loaded within the deadline.
verify: Check the load timestamp against the calendar deadline.
Pass when the load is on or before the deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every program and layer in the placement plan for the planning period.
generic.In-scope period: The planning period aligned to treaty inception dates and instalment schedules.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each forecast line carries program, layer, cession rate, rate change assumption, and phasing.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No program in the placement plan may be missing from the forecast.
generic.Exception handling path: Programs without a supportable rate assumption are escalated to the Reinsurance Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the forecast carries stated assumptions and a bridge from prior-year actuals.
generic.Evidence location: Excel forecast workbook with Sapiens ReinsurancePro treaty data and warehouse premium plan referenced.

steps.title: Build ceded premium from planned gross written premium and cession rates
sop: Pull planned gross written premium by line from the warehouse.
Apply the planned cession rate per program and layer.
Done when base ceded premium is built for every program.
verify: Check every program in the placement plan appears in the build.
Pass when no planned program is missing.

steps.title: Apply the assumed market rate change per layer with its source
sop: Apply the assumed rate change to each layer.
State the source of the assumption for each layer.
Done when rate change assumptions are applied and sourced.
verify: Check each layer records a rate change source.
Pass when no layer is missing its assumption source.

steps.title: Include reinstatement and adjustment premium estimates
sop: Estimate reinstatement premium for non-proportional layers.
Estimate adjustment premium for proportional treaties.
Done when both estimates are included in the forecast.
verify: Check both estimate types appear where the treaty type requires them.
Pass when the estimates cover all applicable treaties.

steps.title: Align phasing to treaty inception and instalment schedules
sop: Phase the forecast to treaty inception dates and instalment schedules.
Confirm the phasing sums to the annual forecast per program.
Done when the phasing is applied and reconciled.
verify: Sum the phased amounts per program against the annual figure.
Pass when phasing sums to the annual forecast.

steps.title: Reconcile the total forecast to prior-year actual with a bridge
sop: Build a bridge from prior-year actual ceded premium to the forecast total.
Explain each movement in the bridge.
Done when the bridge is complete and explained.
verify: Check the bridge movements sum to the forecast total.
Pass when the bridge reconciles with no residual.

steps.title: Review the forecast with the Reinsurance Manager
sop: Review the forecast assumptions and the bridge.
Challenge any rate assumption not supported by market evidence.
Done when the forecast is reviewed and accepted.
verify: Check the review decision is recorded against the forecast version.
Pass when a dated review decision is recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Prior-year actual ceded spend by program and layer plus broker and reinsurer market intelligence.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when actuals reconcile and a dated market view is summarised into per-layer rate assumptions.

sop: Extract prior-year ceded premium by program and layer.
Record the extract date and the period covered.
Done when the prior-year actuals extract is produced.
verify: Check the extract covers the full prior treaty year.
Pass when the period covered matches the prior treaty year.

steps.title: Reconcile the extracted actuals to the general ledger balance
sop: Compare the extract total to the ledger ceded premium balance.
Investigate and record any difference.
Done when the reconciliation is complete.
verify: Compare extract total to ledger balance.
Pass when they agree or the difference is explained.

steps.title: Obtain the broker market report on rate movement by class
sop: Download the broker market report from the broker portal.
Record its publication date and the classes and territories covered.
Done when the dated market report is retained.
verify: Check the report date is within the current renewal cycle.
Pass when a current-cycle dated report is retained.

steps.title: Collect renewal rate indications from lead reinsurers on the panel
sop: Request rate change indications from the lead reinsurers on the current panel.
Record each indication with the reinsurer and date received.
Done when indications are collected or a non-response is logged.
verify: Check every panel lead has an indication or a logged non-response.
Pass when no panel lead is left unrecorded.

steps.title: Summarise the market view into an assumed rate change per layer
sop: Combine broker and reinsurer views into a rate assumption per layer.
State the fallback source where no direct indication exists.
Done when every layer has a rate assumption with a source.
verify: Check no layer is missing a rate assumption or source.
Pass when both are present for every layer.

steps.title: File the input pack for the budgeting working papers
sop: Assemble the actuals, reconciliation, and market evidence into one pack.
File it with the budgeting working papers.
Done when the input pack is filed and retrievable.
verify: Retrieve the pack and check all three components are present.
Pass when actuals, reconciliation, and market evidence all resolve.

generic.Defined scope/population: The approved reinsurance budget loaded to cost centres and accounts in the financial plan.
generic.In-scope period: The planning year covered by the approved budget with monthly phasing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each plan line carries cost centre, general ledger account, amount, and month of phasing.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The loaded plan total equals the approved budget submission with no difference.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Load confirmation retained with the plan version, load date, and approved submission number.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lines rejected by the planning system logged with the correction applied.
generic.Test population: All budget lines loaded into the enterprise financial plan.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No difference may remain between the loaded plan total and the approved budget submission.
generic.Exception handling path: Load differences are escalated to the Reinsurance Manager and corrected before plan sign-off.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the finance planning owner confirms acceptance of the loaded figures.
generic.Evidence location: ERP planning module load log with the Excel reconciliation and ceded accounting mapping retained.

steps.title: Map budget lines to cost centres and general ledger accounts
sop: Map each budget line to its cost centre and ledger account.
Confirm the mapping matches the ceded accounting chart.
Done when every budget line is mapped.
verify: Check each mapped account exists in the ledger chart.
Pass when every mapped account is valid.

steps.title: Load the approved ceded premium budget into the ERP planning module
sop: Load the mapped budget lines into the planning module.
Capture and correct any rejected lines.
Done when all lines are loaded without rejections.
verify: Check the load log for rejected lines.
Pass when no line remains rejected.

steps.title: Load the monthly phasing matching treaty inception and instalments
sop: Load the monthly phasing from the approved submission.
Confirm phasing aligns to inception and instalment dates.
Done when the phasing is loaded for every program.
verify: Sum phased months per program against the annual amount.
Pass when phasing sums to the annual amount.

steps.title: Reconcile the loaded total to the approved budget submission
sop: Compare the loaded plan total to the approved submission total.
Correct any difference immediately.
Done when the loaded total equals the approved total.
verify: Compare loaded total to approved submission total.
Pass when no difference remains.

steps.title: Confirm expected recoveries are reflected on the income side
sop: Check expected reinsurance recoveries are loaded to the income side of the plan.
Reconcile them to the ceded accounting expectation.
Done when recoveries are confirmed present in the plan.
verify: Check the recovery lines exist in the loaded plan.
Pass when recovery lines are present and reconciled.

steps.title: Obtain finance planning owner acceptance of the loaded figures
sop: Present the loaded figures to the finance planning owner.
Record their acceptance against the plan version.
Done when acceptance is recorded.
verify: Check the acceptance record names the plan version.
Pass when acceptance cites the loaded plan version.

generic.Defined scope/population: Budget sensitivity scenarios covering rate change, exposure growth, and reinstatement triggers.
generic.In-scope period: The planning period covered by the central case reinsurance budget.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each scenario records the flexed driver, the flex size, and the restated ceded spend.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every scenario differs from the fixed base case only in the driver being flexed.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Sensitivity workbook retained with the base case version and the modelling run reference.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Scenarios that cannot be modelled logged with the proxy approach used instead.
generic.Test population: All sensitivity scenarios run against the central budget case.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every scenario must reference the same fixed base case to be comparable.
generic.Exception handling path: Scenarios lacking a base case reference are rerun before the range is presented.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the resulting budget range identifies the management central case.
generic.Evidence location: Excel sensitivity workbook with the actuarial platform run and warehouse exposure plan referenced.

steps.title: Fix and record the central budget case as the base
sop: Identify the central case budget version to flex against.
Record its version reference in the sensitivity workbook.
Done when the base case is fixed and referenced.
verify: Check the base case reference matches the current budget version.
Pass when the reference matches the current budget.

steps.title: Flex the assumed rate on line by the agreed bands
sop: Flex rate on line by the agreed plus and minus percentage bands.
Restate ceded spend under each band.
Done when both rate bands are modelled.
verify: Check only the rate driver changed between base and each band.
Pass when each band isolates the rate driver.

steps.title: Flex planned gross written premium growth for proportional cessions
sop: Flex planned gross written premium growth in the model.
Show the effect on proportional cession spend.
Done when the growth sensitivity is modelled.
verify: Check the proportional cession rates are unchanged in the flex.
Pass when only the premium driver changed.

steps.title: Model a mid-year exposure increase requiring a supplemental placement
sop: Model a mid-year exposure increase beyond the placed program.
Cost the supplemental placement required to cover it.
Done when the supplemental placement cost is modelled.
verify: Check the supplemental cost uses current market rate assumptions.
Pass when current rate assumptions are used.

steps.title: Model the cost of one and two full reinstatements triggering
sop: Apply one and then two full reinstatements to the placed layers.
Record the additional premium cost in each case.
Done when both reinstatement cases are costed.
verify: Check the reinstatement terms used match the placed layer terms.
Pass when the terms used match the placed terms.

steps.title: Present the budget range with the central case identified
sop: Combine the scenarios into a budget range around the central case.
Mark the management central case within the range.
Done when the range is presented with the central case identified.
verify: Check every scenario in the range cites the same base case.
Pass when all scenarios cite one base case.

generic.Defined scope/population: The reinsurance budget submission presented for formal approval and its allocation by unit.

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The approved figure equals the figure loaded into the enterprise financial plan.

generic.Test population: The full approved budget including every program allocation.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the signed approval is filed against the submission it approves.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint budget approval folder with the ERP planning entry referenced for the loaded figure.

steps.title: Confirm the submitted budget version is the one being approved
sop: Identify the numbered submission tabled for approval.
Confirm no later version exists in SharePoint.
Done when the version for approval is confirmed.
verify: Check the SharePoint library for a later submission version.
Pass when the tabled version is the latest.

steps.title: Obtain CFO or budget committee sign-off on total ceded spend
sop: Present total ceded spend and its allocation for sign-off.
Obtain the signature or minuted committee decision.
Done when sign-off is obtained.
verify: Check the sign-off names the approver and the date.
Pass when approver and date are both recorded.

steps.title: Record any spend cap or condition attached to the approval
sop: Record any spend cap or condition imposed at approval.
Name the owner responsible for monitoring it.
Done when caps and conditions are recorded with owners.
verify: Check each condition carries an owner.
Pass when no condition lacks an owner.

steps.title: Confirm the approved figure matches what will be loaded to the plan
sop: Compare the approved total to the figure prepared for the ERP plan load.
Resolve any difference before loading.
Done when approved and load figures agree.
verify: Compare the two figures directly.
Pass when no difference remains.

steps.title: File the signed approval against the budget submission record
sop: File the signed approval in the SharePoint budget library.
Link it to the numbered submission it approves.
Done when the approval is filed and linked.
verify: Retrieve the approval and check the linked submission number.
Pass when the linked submission is the approved one.

steps.title: Notify the finance planning team that the budget is approved
sop: Notify finance planning that the budget is approved for loading.
State the approved total and any spend cap.
Done when the notification is sent and recorded.
verify: Check the notification states the approved total and cap.
Pass when both appear in the notification.

generic.Defined scope/population: Ceded premium, recoveries, forecast, and ERM dependency metrics for every active program.
generic.In-scope period: The reporting period year to date plus the full-year forecast.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Report holds actual, budget, variance, full-year forecast, and dependency metrics per program.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reported ceded spend reconciles to the ceded accounting balances for the same period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Issued report retained in SharePoint with the reporting period and data extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Spend cap breaches or expected breaches logged with the proposed action and owner.
generic.Test population: All active reinsurance programs in the reporting period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No unexplained difference may remain between reported spend and ceded accounting balances.
