generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when actuals, forecast, and ERM metrics are reported and reconciled to source.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI report published to SharePoint with the ceded accounting extract retained alongside.

steps.title: Extract year-to-date actual ceded premium and recoveries by program
sop: Extract year-to-date ceded premium and recoveries from the ceded accounting platform.
Record the extract date and period covered.
Done when the year-to-date actuals are extracted.
verify: Check the extract period matches the reporting period.
Pass when the periods align exactly.

steps.title: Compare actuals to budget by program in Power BI
sop: Load actuals and budget into the Power BI report by program.
Calculate year-to-date variance for each program.
Done when the actual versus budget view is built.
verify: Check every active program appears in the view.
Pass when no active program is missing.

steps.title: Report the full-year forecast and variance to approved budget
sop: Update the full-year forecast for known rate and volume movements.
Show the forecast variance against the approved budget.
Done when the full-year forecast and variance are reported.
verify: Check the forecast basis is stated on the report.
Pass when the forecast basis is stated.

steps.title: Report the ERM reinsurance dependency metrics
sop: Report net retained exposure and counterparty concentration.
Compare each metric to its ERM threshold.
Done when the dependency metrics are reported with thresholds.
verify: Check each metric shows its ERM threshold.
Pass when every metric carries its threshold.

steps.title: Highlight spend cap breaches with the proposed action
sop: Identify any actual or expected breach of the approved spend cap.
State the proposed action and owner for each.
Done when every breach carries a proposed action.
verify: Check each identified breach has an action and owner.
Pass when no breach lacks an action and owner.

steps.title: Reconcile reported figures to the ceded accounting balances
sop: Compare reported ceded spend to the ceded accounting balances for the period.
Explain any difference before issuing the report.
Done when the reconciliation is complete and the report is issued.
verify: Compare the reported total to the ceded accounting balance.
Pass when they agree or the difference is explained.

generic.Defined scope/population: The draft reinsurance budget by program plus the allocation basis for each business unit.
generic.In-scope period: The planning period the draft budget covers ahead of final submission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Minutes record attendees, challenges raised, agreed changes, owners, and target dates.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assumed cession rates in the budget match the underwriting plan by line of business.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Affordability challenges and requested structural changes logged with owner and decision.
generic.Test population: All programs and business unit allocations reviewed in the session.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when minutes record attendees, challenges, and agreed changes with owners and dates.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint budget review folder with the Excel draft budget and the Teams meeting record.

steps.title: Circulate the draft budget to finance and underwriting leadership
sop: Send the draft budget and allocation basis ahead of the session.
Confirm the recipient list covers finance and underwriting leadership.
Done when the draft has been circulated to all attendees.
verify: Check the circulation list against the intended attendee list.
Pass when every intended attendee received the draft.

steps.title: Walk through ceded spend by program against prior year
sop: Present ceded spend by program against prior year and planned premium growth.
Explain the drivers of the movement.
Done when spend by program has been walked through.
verify: Check every program with material spend was covered.
Pass when no material program was omitted.

steps.title: Confirm assumed cession rates match the underwriting plan
sop: Compare assumed cession rates to the underwriting plan by line.
Correct or challenge any rate that does not match.
Done when every cession rate is confirmed or challenged.
verify: Check each line's cession rate against the underwriting plan.
Pass when no unexplained rate difference remains.

steps.title: Confirm the allocation basis with business unit finance leads
sop: Present the allocation basis and allocated amounts by unit.
Record acceptance or challenge from each finance lead.
Done when every unit lead has responded.
verify: Check each affected unit has an acceptance or challenge recorded.
Pass when no affected unit is left without a response.

steps.title: Capture affordability challenges and requested structural changes
sop: Record challenges on affordability and any structural change requested.
Note the response given to each.
Done when all challenges and responses are minuted.
verify: Check no minuted challenge lacks a response.
Pass when every challenge has a response.

steps.title: Log agreed changes with owners and dates for the final submission
sop: Log every agreed change with an owner and a target date.
Route the log into the budget finalisation step.
Done when the change log is complete and routed.
verify: Check each logged change has an owner and date.
Pass when no change lacks an owner or date.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each tracker row holds program, month, actual, phased budget, and year-to-date variance.

generic.Test population: All treaties expiring in the renewal period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No treaty expiring in the renewal period may be missing from the strategy document.
generic.Exception handling path: Treaties with conflicting inuring dependencies are escalated to the Head of Reinsurance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when every renewing treaty has a target structure, target rate, and panel intention.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint strategy library with the reinsurance admin treaty extract and Excel target table.

steps.title: List every treaty renewing at 1/1 and off-cycle with current terms
sop: Extract expiring treaties and their current terms from the admin system.
Record each inception date and current structure.
Done when the renewing treaty list is complete.
verify: Compare the list to the treaty expiry schedule.
Pass when every expiring treaty is listed.

steps.title: State the target structure change per treaty
sop: State whether each treaty renews as expiring, restructures, or is not renewed.
Record the rationale for each intent.
Done when every treaty has a stated target change.
verify: Check each treaty records an intent and rationale.
Pass when both are present for every treaty.

steps.title: Set the target rate and maximum acceptable rate change per layer
sop: Set the target rate on line for each layer.
Set the maximum acceptable rate change before escalation.
Done when both targets are set for every layer.
verify: Check every layer has a target rate and maximum change.
Pass when no layer is missing either value.

steps.title: Identify treaties where the panel should change and why
sop: Identify treaties where the current panel should be changed.
State the reason such as security, capacity, or claims behaviour.
Done when panel change intentions are recorded.
verify: Check each panel change records a stated reason.
Pass when every panel change has a reason.

steps.title: Note inuring dependencies constraining the placement sequence
sop: Identify dependencies between treaties including inuring order.
State how they constrain the placement sequence.
Done when the dependencies and their constraints are recorded.
verify: Check each dependency names the treaties involved.
Pass when every dependency names both treaties.

steps.title: Publish the renewal strategy document for review
sop: Review the strategy for coverage of every renewing treaty.
Publish it to SharePoint with a version reference.
Done when the versioned strategy is published.
verify: Check the published strategy covers every expiring treaty.
Pass when no expiring treaty is absent.

generic.Defined scope/population: The target panel, lead, maximum lines, and placement approach for every layer going to market.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal cycle before any market is approached.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each layer records target markets, intended lead, maximum line, approach, and meeting timing.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Target lines across the intended panel cover at least one hundred percent of each layer.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved plan retained in SharePoint with the approval date recorded before market approach.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Markets failing security or concentration screening logged with the exclusion decision.
generic.Test population: All target markets across all layers in the engagement plan.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: No target market may be included that fails the approved security or concentration criteria.
generic.Exception handling path: Screening failures are removed by the Reinsurance Credit & Security Analyst before approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the plan is approved before any market is approached.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint engagement plan folder with the broker portal and Reinsurer Exchange market lists.

steps.title: Define the target panel and intended lead per layer
sop: Define the target markets and the intended lead for each layer.
Set the maximum line acceptable per reinsurer.
Done when panel, lead, and maximum line are defined per layer.
verify: Check target lines cover at least one hundred percent per layer.
Pass when every layer is at least fully covered by targets.

steps.title: Screen every target market against approved security criteria
sop: Screen each target market against the approved security rating criteria.
Exclude or flag markets that fail.
Done when every target market has a screening result.
verify: Check no included market fails the security criteria.
Pass when all included markets pass screening.

steps.title: Screen the panel against counterparty concentration limits
sop: Aggregate intended exposure per reinsurer across all layers.
Compare against the counterparty concentration limits.
Done when concentration screening is complete.
verify: Check no reinsurer exceeds its concentration limit in the plan.
Pass when no planned concentration breach remains.

steps.title: Set the placement approach per layer
sop: Choose firm order, quote-and-sign, or open market for each layer.
State the reason for the chosen approach.
Done when every layer has a stated placement approach.
verify: Check each layer records an approach and a reason.
Pass when both are present for every layer.

steps.title: Sequence market meetings against the renewal calendar
sop: Set the sequence and timing of market meetings.
Align them to the renewal calendar milestones.
Done when meeting timing is set for every target market.
verify: Check each meeting falls within the calendar submission window.
Pass when all meetings sit within the window.

steps.title: Obtain approval of the plan before any market is approached
sop: Submit the plan for approval with the screening results attached.
Withhold market approach until approval is recorded.
Done when the plan is approved and the approval date recorded.
verify: Check the approval date precedes the first market approach.
Pass when approval predates any market approach.

generic.Defined scope/population: The renewal strategy per treaty, the target spend, and the resulting retained net position.
generic.In-scope period: The renewal cycle ahead of strategy pre-approval.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Minutes record the strategy version reviewed, challenges raised, responses, and required changes.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Target spend presented agrees to the approved reinsurance budget for the planning year.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Minutes and reviewed strategy version retained in SharePoint with the session date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Challenges on cost, structure, or panel logged with the response or the change required.
generic.Test population: All treaties and programs covered by the strategy reviewed.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Required changes must be recorded before the strategy proceeds to pre-approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved challenges are carried by the Head of Reinsurance into the pre-approval session.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when minutes record the strategy reviewed, challenges, and changes required.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint renewal strategy folder with the Teams meeting record and session minutes.

steps.title: Circulate the strategy to senior management before the session
sop: Send the strategy document and market view ahead of the session.
Confirm the recipient list covers the intended attendees.
Done when the strategy has been circulated to all attendees.
verify: Check the circulation list against the intended attendees.
Pass when every intended attendee received it.

steps.title: Walk through the renewal strategy per treaty
sop: Present the strategy per treaty and the expected market conditions.
Explain the target structure change for each.
Done when every treaty strategy has been walked through.
verify: Check every renewing treaty was covered in the session.
Pass when no renewing treaty was omitted.

steps.title: Present target spend against budget and the hardening range
sop: Present target ceded spend against the approved budget.
Show the expected range if the market hardens.
Done when spend and range have been presented.
verify: Check the budget figure cited is the approved budget total.
Pass when the cited figure is the approved total.

steps.title: Present the retained net position under the target structure
sop: Present the modelled retained net position under the target structure.
Compare it to the approved retention and appetite.
Done when the net position has been presented with comparisons.
verify: Check the modelled figures tie to the structuring outputs.
Pass when the figures reconcile to the modelling outputs.

steps.title: Capture challenges on cost, structure, and panel with responses
sop: Record each challenge raised and the response given.
Note any challenge deferred to further analysis.
Done when all challenges and responses are minuted.
verify: Check no minuted challenge lacks a response or deferral.
Pass when every challenge carries a response or deferral.

steps.title: Record the changes required before pre-approval
sop: Record the changes required to the strategy before pre-approval.
Assign an owner and date to each change.
Done when required changes are recorded with owners and dates.
verify: Check each required change has an owner and a date.
Pass when no change lacks an owner or date.

generic.Defined scope/population: The multi-year program roadmap covering structure, spend, panel, and market cycle assumptions.
generic.In-scope period: The next one to three planning years following the completed renewal.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Roadmap records baseline structure, planned changes, cycle view, panel plan, and version number.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The new baseline structure matches the actual placed structure from the renewal records.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reissued roadmap retained in SharePoint with a version number and a change note.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Debrief conclusions not carried into the roadmap logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: All programs and layers represented in the multi-year roadmap.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: The roadmap must be reissued with a version number and a change note versus the prior version.
generic.Exception handling path: Conflicts between debrief conclusions and the roadmap are resolved by the Head of Reinsurance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the placed structure is the new baseline and changes versus prior version are noted.
generic.Evidence location: SharePoint roadmap library with the Excel multi-year structure plan and debrief record linked.

steps.title: Set the actual placed structure as the new roadmap baseline
sop: Replace the prior baseline with the actual placed structure.
Confirm it matches the final placement records.
Done when the new baseline is in place.
verify: Compare the baseline to the final placement records.
Pass when the baseline matches the placed structure.

steps.title: Reflect debrief conclusions on structural changes to pursue
sop: Carry the debrief conclusions into the one to three year plan.
Record any conclusion deliberately not carried and why.
Done when every debrief conclusion is reflected or reasoned out.
verify: Check each debrief conclusion appears or has a stated reason.
Pass when none is silently dropped.

steps.title: Update the multi-year market cycle view and its spend effect
sop: Update the assumed market cycle direction for the plan years.
Show the effect on planned ceded spend by year.
Done when the cycle view and spend effect are updated.
verify: Check the cycle view cites the market analysis it draws on.
Pass when the cycle view cites a dated market analysis.

steps.title: Update planned panel diversification and partner relationships
sop: Update the planned panel diversification targets.
Record the long-term partner reinsurer relationships to build.
Done when panel plans are updated.
verify: Check the panel plan is consistent with concentration limits.
Pass when no planned concentration breach remains.

steps.title: Write the change note versus the previous roadmap version
sop: List what changed from the previous roadmap version.
State the reason for each change.
Done when the change note is written.
verify: Check each change in the roadmap appears in the note.
Pass when every change is covered by the note.

steps.title: Reissue the roadmap with a version number to SharePoint
sop: Apply a version number and reissue the roadmap.
Circulate it with the change note to the reinsurance team and finance.
Done when the versioned roadmap is reissued and circulated.
verify: Check the reissued roadmap carries a version number and change note.
Pass when both are present on the reissued document.
